verdict.rationale: Galileo explicitly supports building datasets from production/live data (galileo-docs-11), running Experiments against datasets with chosen metrics (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-3), and creating/managing datasets via MCP or SDK (galileo-docs-4). Production trace capture and logging infrastructure (galileo-docs-6, galileo-gh-1) feed directly into this offline eval workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the trace-to-dataset curation workflow and more detail on dataset versioning/curation UI beyond docs claims.
